7.1.en: Krishna: "Keep your mind on me and practise, and I'll show you how to know me completely."
7.1.hi: Krishna: "Mind mujh pe rakho aur practice karo, main batata hoon mujhe poori tarah kaise jaano."

7.2.en: "I'll give you the full knowledge and the lived experience. After this, there's nothing left to figure out."
7.2.hi: "Main tumhe poora gyaan aur uska anubhav dunga. Iske baad kuch samajhna baaki nahi rahega."

7.3.en: Out of thousands, a few try. Out of those trying, very few truly get it. Rare, but possible.
7.3.hi: Hazaaron mein se kuch koshish karte hain. Unme se bahut kam sach mein samajhte hain. Rare hai, par possible.

7.4.en: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect, ego: these eight make up my material side.
7.4.hi: Dharti, paani, aag, hawa, aakash, mind, buddhi, ego: ye aath mera material side hain.

7.5.en: That's my lower nature. My higher nature is the life force that keeps the whole universe running.
7.5.hi: Ye meri neeche wali nature hai. Oonchi nature woh life force hai jo poore universe ko chalati hai.

7.6.en: Matter plus life force creates everything. And I'm the source and the end of it all.
7.6.hi: Matter aur life force milke sab banate hain. Aur sabka shuru aur ant main hoon.

7.7.en: Nothing is higher than me. Everything is strung on me like pearls on a thread.
7.7.hi: Mujhse ooncha kuch nahi. Sab kuch mujh mein aise piroya hai jaise dhaage mein moti.

7.8.en: I'm the taste of water, the light of the sun and moon, the Om in prayers. Look closely and you'll see me everywhere.
7.8.hi: Main paani ka swaad, suraj-chaand ki roshni, prarthana ka Om hoon. Dhyaan se dekho, main har jagah hoon.

7.9.en: I'm the fresh smell of earth, the heat in fire, the life in every being, the discipline in the disciplined.
7.9.hi: Main mitti ki khushboo, aag ki garmi, har jeev ki jaan, aur tapasvi ka discipline hoon.

7.10.en: I'm the original seed of all beings, the intelligence of the smart, and the shine of the brilliant.
7.10.hi: Main sab jeevon ka asli beej, samajhdaar ki buddhi, aur talented ki chamak hoon.

7.11.en: I'm strength without greed, and desire that doesn't go against what's right. Healthy ambition is divine.
7.11.hi: Main bina laalach wali taakat hoon, aur woh chahat jo dharm ke khilaaf nahi. Healthy ambition bhi divine hai.

7.12.en: Every mood, calm, restless or lazy, comes from me. But I'm not trapped in them; they're in me.
7.12.hi: Har mood, shaant, bechain ya aalsi, mujhse aata hai. Par main unme phansa nahi; woh mujh mein hain.

7.13.en: People get so caught up in their moods that they miss what's beyond them: me.
7.13.hi: Log apne moods mein itna phans jaate hain ki unke pare jo hai, yaani mujhe, miss kar dete hain.

7.14.en: This illusion is hard to escape. But those who turn to me get through it.
7.14.hi: Ye maya se bachna mushkil hai. Par jo meri sharan aate hain, woh paar ho jaate hain.

7.15.en: People who keep doing harm, lost in confusion and ego, don't turn to me. They're stuck.
7.15.hi: Jo log nuksaan karte rehte hain, confusion aur ego mein khoye hain, woh meri taraf nahi aate. Woh phanse hain.

7.16.en: Four kinds of good people turn to me: those in pain, the curious, those who need help, and the wise.
7.16.hi: Chaar tarah ke achhe log mere paas aate hain: dukhi, jigyasu, zaroorat wale, aur gyaani.

7.17.en: Of these, the wise one who loves me for my own sake is the best. We're very dear to each other.
7.17.hi: Inme se jo gyaani bina kisi wajah mujhe pyaar karta hai, woh sabse best hai. Hum ek dusre ko bahut pyaare hain.

7.18.en: All of them are good, but the wise one feels like my own self. They want nothing but me.
7.18.hi: Sab achhe hain, par gyaani mujhe apna hi roop lagta hai. Use mere siva kuch nahi chahiye.

7.19.en: After many lives, the wise realise "the Divine is everything" and come to me. Such souls are rare.
7.19.hi: Kai janam ke baad gyaani samajhte hain ki "sab kuch Bhagwan hi hai" aur mere paas aate hain. Aise log rare hain.

7.20.en: People driven by wants turn to other gods for quick results, based on their own nature.
7.20.hi: Chahaton se chalne wale log jaldi result ke liye dusre devtaon ke paas jaate hain, apni nature ke hisaab se.

7.21.en: Whatever form someone worships with faith, I make their faith stronger.
7.21.hi: Koi jis bhi roop ki pooja bharose se kare, main uska bharosa aur pakka kar deta hoon.

7.22.en: They pray with faith and get what they want, but really, it's me giving it.
7.22.hi: Woh bharose se maangte hain aur unhe milta hai, par asli mein main hi de raha hoon.

7.23.en: Those small rewards don't last. Aim for the gods and you reach them. Aim for me and you reach me.
7.23.hi: Woh chhote rewards tikte nahi. Devtaon ko aim karo toh unhe paoge. Mujhe aim karo toh mujhe paoge.

7.24.en: People who don't get it think I'm just a person who showed up. They miss my unlimited side.
7.24.hi: Jo nahi samajhte, woh sochte hain main bas ek insaan hoon jo aa gaya. Mera unlimited side miss kar dete hain.

7.25.en: I'm hidden behind illusion, so not everyone sees me. The world doesn't recognise that I'm eternal.
7.25.hi: Main maya ke peeche chhupa hoon, isliye sabko nahi dikhta. Duniya nahi pehchanti ki main hamesha hoon.

7.26.en: I know everyone: past, present and future. But nobody truly knows me.
7.26.hi: Main sabko jaanta hoon: bhoot, vartmaan aur bhavishya. Par mujhe koi sach mein nahi jaanta.

7.27.en: From birth, everyone gets trapped in love-hate cycles. That's what confuses us.
7.27.hi: Janam se hi sab pasand-naapasand ke cycle mein phans jaate hain. Yahi humein confuse karta hai.

7.28.en: Those who keep doing good eventually break free of that cycle and commit to me fully.
7.28.hi: Jo achha karte rehte hain, woh aakhir mein us cycle se nikalte hain aur poori tarah mujhse jud jaate hain.

7.29.en: Those who turn to me to get past ageing and death come to understand the whole truth.
7.29.hi: Jo budhape aur maut se paar jaane ke liye meri sharan aate hain, woh poora sach samajh jaate hain.

7.30.en: Those who know me in every part of life keep remembering me, even at the very end.
7.30.hi: Jo mujhe life ke har hisse mein jaante hain, woh aakhri pal mein bhi mujhe yaad rakhte hain.
